title: Toll Tag Replenishment Failure Warning
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tolltag:trip
| stats latest(balance_usd) as balance_usd, latest(auto_replenish_status) as auto_replenish_status by transponder_id
| where balance_usd<20 AND auto_replenish_status!="enabled"
| sort balance_usd
description: Uses Toll-tag balance exports telemetry to monitor low tag balances without automatic replenishment in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for drivers who may hit a payment issue on the next toll road, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Toll-tag balance exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Transponder table of balance and replenishment status.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges low tag balances without automatic replenishment so you can spot drivers who may hit a payment issue on the next toll road before it becomes annoying.
